packages.label: מָמוֹן וְעֲנָפִים
packages.reason: The largest connected component in Torah #69 centers on ממון (wealth) as the core concept. The Torah teaches that money is not a material object but rather the manifestation — the 'shining-forth and spreading' (התנוצצות והתפשטות) — of the wife's soul-light. All nodes in this cluster share the same essential nature: they are different expressions of how the wife's soul-light extends outward as material wealth. The 'branches of the tree' (ענפים) = the soul-light's radiance = ממון. The 'wall' (חומה) = ממון (from Proverbs 18:11 'hon ashir kiryat uzo u'ke-chomah nisgavah'). The left hand (שמאל) = ממון (from Proverbs 3:16 'bismoalah osher ve-khavod' — wealth is on the left side of Wisdom). The tree-root (עקר האילן) = the wife's soul-light (אור נפשה) — explicitly: 'אוֹר נַפְשָׁהּ הוּא בְּחִינַת עִקַּר הָאִילָן'; this pair (originally isolated component D) is merged here because the tree-root's essential nature in this Torah is the SOURCE of the wealth-branches, placing it squarely in the tree/wealth metaphor domain rather than in the abstract soul/feminine domain. Tzedaka (צדקה) = שלח ('שַׁלַּח לַחְמְךָ עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם') — giving forth/releasing wealth is the bechina of Kohelet's 'send forth.' This pair (originally isolated component H) is merged here because both concepts express the same essential nature: the voluntary release/transmission of wealth as a holy act that mirrors the soul-light's natural outflow. Polarity is neutral: ממון itself is not good or evil — the same soul-light framework describes both legitimate wealth (a gift from the wife's soul) and stolen wealth (a grasping of the neighbor's soul-light). The left-hand/שמאל designation is structural, not pejorative.

merge_notes.reason: The pair 'wife's soul-light = root of the tree' is the hinge of the entire tree metaphor. In this Torah the soul-light is described exclusively in its role as the generative source that produces branches (ממון). The bechina declared is אור נפשה = עקר האילן; this root's NATURE in Torah #69 is 'the source from which wealth-branches emerge' — it belongs with the wealth/tree cluster, not with the abstract soul-ontology cluster (Package 2).

Tzedakah is equated to 'שַׁלַּח' (the act of sending forth, from Kohelet 11:1). The shared nature is: voluntarily releasing wealth is the same act as the natural outflow of soul-light. This is the positive counterpart to gzeilah — where theft takes the soul-light by force, tzedakah sends it forth willingly. Both concepts belong in the wealth-domain cluster because their essential nature is about the correct vs. incorrect relationship to ממון.

packages.label: נֶפֶשׁ וּנְקֵבָה
packages.reason: The second-largest connected component groups all nodes that describe the essential nature of the feminine/receptive dimension of the soul. The core insight: the nefesh (lowest soul-level) IS the feminine (nekeivah), because the lowest level of any hierarchy is — relative to the level above it — in the position of receiver/feminine. This yields: נפש = נקבה = רגלים (feet — the lowest part of the body, from Zohar Vayera: 'raglei chasidav yishmor — da ita'). The bat-zug (wife/soul-mate) = רגלין because she IS the nefesh-aspect of her husband. The entire lower-level hierarchy principle is captured in: 'כְּלַל הַמַּדְרֵגָה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה הִיא בְחִינַת נְקֵבָה נֶגֶד מַדְרֵגָה שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה הֵימֶנָּה.' The isolated pair (component C) — 'כְּלַל נֶפֶשׁ רוּחַ וּנְשָׁמָה שֶׁלָּהּ' = 'נֶפֶשׁ נֶגְדּוֹ' — is merged here because it states the same principle at the meta-level: even the wife's ENTIRE nefesh-ruach-neshamah is considered 'nefesh' relative to her husband. This is a restatement of the fundamental nefesh=feminine principle and belongs in this package. Polarity is neutral: the nefesh/nekeivah/raglayim structure is ontological — it describes the soul's architecture. The same dimension can be in holiness (receiving from her husband, building children) or in captivity among the klipot (her feet descend to death).

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair states the ontological principle at the collective level: the wife's entire three-part soul (nefesh-ruach-neshamah) is considered 'nefesh' relative to the husband's higher standing. This is a direct extension of the nefesh=nekeivah principle already in Component B. The shared nature is identical: 'lowest/receptive dimension = nefesh = feminine.' Merges into Package 2.

packages.label: בָּנִים וְתוֹרָה
packages.reason: This cluster groups the fruit/children domain together with the Torah/right-hand domain. The core bechinas: בנים (children) = הפרות הגדלים בענפים האלו (the fruits growing on the tree's branches) = למודי ה' (Torah-students — from Isaiah 54: 'וְכָל בָּנַיִךְ לִמּוּדֵי ה''). Children are not merely biological offspring — they are Torah-students by essential nature. The isolated pair תורה = ימין (Torah is the right side, from Deuteronomy 33: 'מִימִינוֹ אֵשׁ דָּת לָמוֹ') is merged here because its shared nature is the same domain: Torah as the holy right-hand path that produces worthy children. In the Torah's argument: the wise man (chakham) marries for the sake of Torah (=ימין), and this produces worthy/fitting children — because learning Torah in purity = the proper intent for marriage. By contrast, the fool marries for ממון (=שמאל/left) and produces unfit children. The Torah=ימין pair belongs with the children=Torah-students cluster because both describe the positive goal of holy marriage: producing children who are Torah-students, achieved by orienting toward Torah (ימין) rather than money (שמאל). Polarity is good: all nodes here belong to the positive/holy domain — children as limudei Hashem, Torah as the right hand of God.

merge_notes.reason: Torah = ימין (the right hand/side) — this is the positive-orientation principle in Torah #69. In the teaching, the chakham who marries l'shem Torah orients to ימין and produces children who are limudei Hashem. The shared nature of תורה and ימין is 'the holy/right-hand path,' which is the same essential domain as בנים=למודי ה'. The Torah-right pair and the children-Torah-students pair both describe the same domain: holiness, learning, and righteous offspring as the proper goal of marriage. Merges into Package 3.

packages.label: שְׂעָרוֹת וּמֹחִין
packages.reason: This cluster groups all nodes belonging to the domain of brain-overflow (מותרי מחין) and its physical/spiritual manifestations. The core: מותרי מחין (surplus/overflow of the brain) = שערות (hairs, which are the physical manifestation of brain-overflow in kabbalistic anatomy) = מותרות (excesses). The tefillin-straps (רצועות) = מותרי מחין, because the straps are the 'overflow' portion of the tefillin, extending beyond the head-box. The brain (מחין) itself = תפלין (tefillin head-box), a well-established Lurianic equation. Two small isolated pairs are merged in: (1) מחין=תפלין (component G2) — shares the same essential nature as the whole cluster (brain anatomy expressed through tefillin). (2) שערות של החכם = שַׁעַר בְּיָמִין (component G3) — the wise man's hairs are not mere overflow but 'gates' (שערים) on the right side, through which he opens the gates of wisdom for those who need him to lower himself to their level. This is the POSITIVE pole of the שערות domain. Polarity is neutral because this cluster contains both poles: the wise man's שערות are holy gates (שַׁעַר בְּיָמִין), while the fool's שערות are empty sinah-chinam coming from brain-overflow that exceeds the brain's capacity. The same ontological structure (motarei mochin = hair) produces radically different outcomes depending on whether the person is a chakham or a kesil. This dual-pole structure within one cluster is marked as neutral.

merge_notes.reason: The brain (מחין) = tefillin (the head-box) — a foundational Lurianic equation cited here as: 'מֹחִין, בְּחִינַת תְּפִלִּין, בְּחִינַת מֶלֶךְ אָסוּר בָּרְהָטִים, בְּרַהֲטֵי מֹחִין.' This pair shares the essential domain of the שערות/מותרי מחין cluster: both are about the brain and its kabbalistic-anatomical expression through tefillin. מחין is the inner substance; מותרי מחין is the overflow of that same substance; and תפלין is the structural container. All three are the same essential domain.

The wise man's hairs (שערות של החכם) = a gate on the right (שַׁעַר בְּיָמִין) — explicitly: 'שְֹּעָרוֹת שֶׁל הֶחָכָם, הֵם בְחִינַת שַׁעַר בְּיָמִין.' This is the positive-pole expression of the שערות domain: the same מותרי מחין that produces sinah chinam in the fool becomes, in the wise man, 'gates' through which he humbles himself to bring people closer to God. The shared nature is identical — motarei mochin / שערות — but in the wise man it opens rather than closes. Merges into Package 4.
